source_sampling: uniform eligible physical point IDs without replacement; use all if fewer than2048
targets: all16 frames times all selected cameras; all sources
scale: one mean-depth GT-assisted scalar per checkpoint and clip across all sources/targets/times
inference: one original full forward, eval,inference_mode,BF16; no query chunking
selection: First10 distinct task groups per family in frozen campaign order; first episode eligible in ALL selected source views for BOTH strides; try same-group episodes first, then unused groups; no inference before selection; retain rejected IDs/reasons
unseen_label: robotwin and robocasa train partitions are held-out dataset diagnostics for two-datasets models
class_losses: dynamic_loss and static_loss added alongside unchanged pooled loss; missing classes are null

strict_single.input: Exactly one physical camera, 16 frames; each physical camera is a separate forward
strict_single.query: Reuse the corresponding original source=target diagonal; remap both local view IDs to zero; no resampling
strict_single.source: Same source-first-frame point IDs, UV, GT, visibility, dynamic labels, episode scale and center
strict_single.scale: One depth scalar per independent single-video forward across all16 frames; no per-frame fit
strict_single.scoring: Original dense_protocol.score with V=1, unchanged formulas; query-weighted aggregation
strict_single.multiview: Original MV checkpoint results are retained without rerunning

evaluation_input_by_stage.single: One physical camera per forward, same-camera queries
evaluation_input_by_stage.multi: Full multiview input and all ordered view pairs
